blocks.zh: 10.0 Considerations for Investigation 10.0 調查考量事項
blocks.en: 10.0 Considerations for Investigation

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Root Cause (根本原因)：導致 APS 失敗的最底層原因。TR22 強調，調查不能只停留在「表面原因」（例如「瓶子有菌」），必須追溯到可歸因的合理原因（Assignable Plausible Cause）。如果找不到明確根本原因，製程不得繼續運作。
blocks.en: Root Cause: The most fundamental cause of an APS failure. TR22 stresses that an investigation must not stop at the "surface cause" (for example, "the vial was contaminated"); it must trace back to an assignable, plausible cause. If no clear root cause can be found, the process must not continue to operate.

blocks.zh: Scope & Time Frame (範圍與時間框架)：回溯評估不是固定「追溯到上次成功 APS」就好。如果失敗原因是間歇性設備故障（不易被例行維護偵測），可能需要回溯所有效期內的生產批次。範圍也不侷限於單一產線 — 若問題出在冷凍乾燥機，則使用該設備的所有產品都可能受影響。
blocks.en: Scope & Time Frame: The retrospective evaluation is not simply "back to the last successful APS". If the failure was caused by an intermittent equipment fault (one that routine maintenance would not easily detect), it may be necessary to look back over all batches produced within the applicable period. The scope is also not limited to a single line: if the problem lies with the lyophilizer, all products that use that equipment may be affected.

blocks.zh: Species-Level Identification (物種層級鑑定)：所有陽性單元必須至少鑑定到物種層級，建議進行菌株分型（Strain Typing）。這些鑑定結果要與 EM 資料庫、無菌試驗、生物負荷檢測等來源進行比對，以追蹤污染來源。
blocks.en: Species-Level Identification: All positive units must be identified to at least species level, and strain typing is recommended. These identification results should be compared with EM databases, sterility test results, bioburden data and other sources to trace the source of contamination.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: APS 失敗調查就像飛安事故調查：不能只看墜機現場（陽性瓶子），還要回溯航班紀錄（批次紀錄）、檢查飛機維修歷史（設備維護）、訪談機組人員（操作員面談）、調閱黑盒子（錄影回顧）、審查天氣與航路（環境監測數據）。每一條線索都可能指向不同的根因，且必須同時排除所有非相關因素，才能確認真正的根本原因。
blocks.en: An APS failure investigation is like an air accident investigation: you cannot look only at the crash site (the positive vials). You must also go back through the flight records (batch records), check the aircraft maintenance history (equipment maintenance), interview the crew (operator interviews), review the black box (video review), and examine the weather and flight path (environmental monitoring data). Each clue may point to a different root cause, and all unrelated factors must be ruled out at the same time before the true root cause can be confirmed.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 不能在沒有歸因的情況下恢復生產：TR22 明確要求「The aseptic process should not proceed without a cause assigned and corrected」。這是一個非常嚴格的立場 — 在實務中，有些公司可能傾向在調查未完成時就恢復生產，但這違反了本指引的精神。
blocks.en: Production must not resume without an assigned cause: TR22 states explicitly that "The aseptic process should not proceed without a cause assigned and corrected". This is a very strict position. In practice, some companies may be tempted to resume production before the investigation is complete, but that goes against the spirit of this guidance.

blocks.zh: 累積桌（Accumulator Table）會打亂瓶子順序：這個細節非常實用。如果充填線上有累積桌，瓶子的順序會被打亂，使得「時間區間定位」變得困難。因此在 APS 設計時就要考慮如何維持容器的可追溯性。
blocks.en: An accumulator table scrambles the order of the containers: This is a very practical detail. If the filling line has an accumulator table, the sequence of containers is mixed up, which makes it hard to pinpoint the time interval. Container traceability should therefore be considered already at the APS design stage.

blocks.zh: 法規通報評估：調查報告中必須評估是否需要進行法規通報。對 CDMO 而言，這不僅涉及自身的法規義務，也可能影響客戶的上市許可與場地變更通知。
blocks.en: Regulatory notification assessment: The investigation report must assess whether regulatory notification is required. For a CDMO, this involves not only its own regulatory obligations but may also affect the client's marketing authorization and site change notifications.

blocks.zh: 調查報告要素清單 Investigation Report Checklist
blocks.en: Investigation Report Checklist

blocks.zh: TR22 列出的調查報告必要內容可以歸納為以下幾個維度：
blocks.en: The required content of an investigation report listed in TR22 can be summarized in the following dimensions:

blocks.zh: 事件描述：事件摘要
blocks.en: Event description: Summary of the event

blocks.zh: 全面調查：所有系統的調查結論（不僅限於與失敗相關的）
blocks.en: Comprehensive investigation: Conclusions of the investigation of all systems (not only those related to the failure)

blocks.zh: 微生物鑑定：物種層級 + 菌株特徵
blocks.en: Microbial identification: Species level plus strain characterization

blocks.zh: 根因分析：結論與支持文件
blocks.en: Root cause analysis: Conclusions and supporting documentation

blocks.zh: 影響評估：對先前批次的潛在影響
blocks.en: Impact assessment: Potential impact on previous batches

blocks.zh: 矯正措施：CAPA 及其文件
blocks.en: Corrective actions: CAPA and its documentation

blocks.zh: 後續 APS：額外 APS 次數的理由與結果
blocks.en: Follow-up APS: Rationale for the number of additional APS runs, and the results

blocks.zh: 法規面：是否需要法規通報
blocks.en: Regulatory aspects: Whether regulatory notification is required

blocks.zh: 簽核：調查人員及生產/品質單位簽名
blocks.en: Sign-off: Signatures of the investigators and of the production and quality units

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: CDMO 情境：假設你的 CDMO 在 A 線進行冷凍乾燥產品的 APS 時發現 2 個陽性瓶。調查發現污染菌為水源性微生物，且該菌株與冷凍乾燥機 #2 的冷凝器 EM 樣本匹配。此時你的回溯範圍不應限於 A 線，而是所有使用冷凍乾燥機 #2 的產品（包括 B 線、C 線充填後送至該設備的批次）。時間框架則取決於冷凝器上次清潔驗證通過的時間點。
blocks.en: CDMO scenario: Suppose your CDMO finds 2 positive vials during an APS of a lyophilized product on Line A. The investigation shows that the contaminant is a water-borne organism, and the strain matches an EM sample from the condenser of lyophilizer #2. In this case your retrospective scope should not be limited to Line A. It should cover all products that use lyophilizer #2 (including batches filled on Line B and Line C and then sent to that equipment). The time frame depends on when the condenser last passed cleaning validation.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼 TR22 強調調查範圍不能僅限於發生失敗的那條充填線？請用冷凍乾燥機的例子說明。
blocks.en: Why does TR22 stress that the scope of the investigation must not be limited to the filling line where the failure occurred? Explain with the example of a lyophilizer.

blocks.zh: 在什麼情況下，回溯時間不能只追溯到上次成功的 APS？
blocks.en: Under what circumstances should the look-back period not stop at the last successful APS?

blocks.zh: 如果 APS 調查確定污染是由非無菌培養基引起的，這算是 APS 失敗嗎？後續應如何處理？
blocks.en: If the APS investigation determines that the contamination was caused by non-sterile media, is this still an APS failure? How should it be handled afterwards?

blocks.zh: 累積桌如何影響 APS 失敗調查中的「時間區間定位」？CDMO 可以採取哪些措施來降低這個風險？
blocks.en: How does an accumulator table affect the identification of the time interval in an APS failure investigation? What measures can a CDMO take to reduce this risk?

blocks.zh: 11.0 The Use of Aseptic Process Simulation in Ongoing Process Evaluation 11.0 無菌製程模擬在持續製程評估中的應用
blocks.en: 11.0 The Use of Aseptic Process Simulation in Ongoing Process Evaluation

blocks.zh: Ongoing Process Evaluation (持續製程評估)：無菌製程不是一次驗證就永遠有效的。TR22 強調必須持續評估兩件事：(1) 控制狀態是否維持，(2) 任何變更是否影響了無菌保證能力。這與 FDA 的 Process Validation Lifecycle（製程驗證生命週期）概念一致 — 持續的監測與再確認是確保無菌性的基礎。
blocks.en: Ongoing Process Evaluation: An aseptic process is not valid forever after a single validation. TR22 stresses that two things must be evaluated continuously: (1) whether the state of control is maintained, and (2) whether any change has affected the ability to assure sterility. This is consistent with the FDA Process Validation Lifecycle concept: ongoing monitoring and reconfirmation are the foundation for assuring sterility.

blocks.zh: 11.1 The Role of Aseptic Process Simulation in Ongoing Process Evaluation 11.1 無菌製程模擬在持續製程評估中的角色
blocks.en: 11.1 The Role of Aseptic Process Simulation in Ongoing Process Evaluation

blocks.zh: State of Control (受控狀態)：指無菌製程中所有關鍵系統（環境、設備、人員、物料）持續維持在驗證過的條件範圍內。APS 是驗證「受控狀態」的最終整合測試 — 如果 APS 通過，代表整個系統仍在控制中。
blocks.en: State of Control: All critical systems in the aseptic process (environment, equipment, personnel and materials) remain continuously within their validated conditions. The APS is the final integrated test of the "state of control": if the APS passes, the whole system is still under control.

blocks.zh: CCS (Contamination Control Strategy, 污染控制策略)：EU Annex 1 要求的綜合性文件，整合所有與污染控制相關的措施。APS 的頻率和範圍應與 CCS 的更新保持一致。可參考 PDA TR90 了解 CCS 的詳細開發方法。
blocks.en: CCS (Contamination Control Strategy): A comprehensive document required by EU Annex 1 that integrates all measures related to contamination control. The frequency and scope of APS should be kept consistent with updates to the CCS. See PDA TR90 for detailed guidance on developing a CCS.

blocks.zh: 持續性 APS 就像汽車的定期保養與年檢：即使車子每天都正常運作，你仍然需要定期做全面檢查（定期 APS）。如果中間發生了事故或更換了重要零件（事件驅動 APS），則需要額外的檢查來確認修復後的車子仍然安全。光靠日常目測（EM 監測）不夠，還需要上路測試（APS）來驗證整體性能。
blocks.en: Ongoing APS is like regular servicing and the annual inspection of a car: even if the car runs normally every day, you still need a periodic full inspection (periodic APS). If there is an accident or an important part is replaced in between (event-driven APS), an additional check is needed to confirm that the repaired car is still safe. Visual checks every day (EM monitoring) are not enough; you also need a road test (APS) to verify overall performance.

blocks.zh: TR22 列出的七項考量因素，本質上是在評估「自上次 APS 以來，有什麼變了？」：
blocks.en: The seven considerations listed in TR22 are essentially an assessment of "what has changed since the last APS?":

blocks.zh: 製程變更 → 是否有新的風險引入？
blocks.en: Process changes → Have new risks been introduced?

blocks.zh: EM 數據趨勢 → 環境控制是否劣化？
blocks.en: EM data trends → Has environmental control deteriorated?

blocks.zh: 無菌試驗數據 → 是否有微生物負荷升高的跡象？
blocks.en: Sterility test data → Is there any sign of increased microbial load?

blocks.zh: 滅菌確效數據 → 滅菌能力是否仍然充分？
blocks.en: Sterilization validation data → Is the sterilization capability still adequate?

blocks.zh: 偏差調查 → 是否有系統性問題浮現？
blocks.en: Deviation investigations → Is a systemic problem emerging?

blocks.zh: 風險評估更新 → 是否有新識別的風險？
blocks.en: Risk assessment updates → Have any new risks been identified?

blocks.zh: CCS 更新 → 整體污染控制策略是否仍然適當？
blocks.en: CCS updates → Is the overall contamination control strategy still appropriate?

blocks.zh: 11.2 Periodic (Time-Driven) Ongoing Aseptic Process Simulation Assessment 11.2 定期（時間驅動）持續無菌製程模擬評估
blocks.en: 11.2 Periodic (Time-Driven) Ongoing Aseptic Process Simulation Assessment

blocks.zh: Semiannual Interval (半年一次)：這是業界標準的定期 APS 頻率，與 FDA 指引和 EU Annex 1 的要求一致。「大約每六個月」意味著有一定的彈性，但企業應在 SOP 中定義允許的時間區間範圍及超出時的應對措施。
blocks.en: Semiannual Interval: This is the industry-standard frequency for periodic APS, consistent with FDA guidance and EU Annex 1. "Approximately every six months" allows some flexibility, but a company should define the permitted time window in its SOP, together with the response if it is exceeded.

blocks.zh: Single APS Run (單次 APS 執行)：如果自上次 APS 以來沒有製程變更且沒有其他異常跡象，定期評估只需執行一次 APS 即可。這與初始驗證（通常需要三次）不同。
blocks.en: Single APS Run: If there have been no process changes since the last APS and no other signs of abnormality, the periodic assessment needs only one APS run. This differs from initial validation, which usually requires three runs.

blocks.zh: 時間區間偏差（Time-Interval Deviation）：如果因為排程困難或其他原因導致定期 APS 未能在預定時間內完成，這本身就是一個偏差，需要記錄和評估風險。對 CDMO 而言，管理多條產線、多種產品的 APS 排程是一項重要的後勤挑戰。
blocks.en: Time-Interval Deviation: If a periodic APS cannot be completed within the scheduled time because of scheduling difficulties or other reasons, this is itself a deviation and must be documented and its risk evaluated. For a CDMO, scheduling APS for multiple lines and multiple products is a significant logistical challenge.

blocks.zh: 公式與計算 Formula
blocks.en: Formula

blocks.zh: CDMO 年度 APS 排程估算：
blocks.en: CDMO annual APS schedule estimate:

blocks.zh:
假設 CDMO 有 3 條無菌充填線，每線有 2 種充填設定：
  每線每半年 1 次 APS = 3 線 x 2 次/年 = 6 次 APS/年（最低）
  若含人員再驗證 APS = 額外考量新進/輪調人員
  若有事件驅動 APS = 視偏差與變更數量而定

  典型 CDMO 每年可能需要 10-20 次 APS
  每次 APS 成本（培養基 + 人力 + 停線）≈ USD 15,000-50,000
  年度 APS 預算 ≈ USD 150,000-1,000,000
blocks.en:
Assume a CDMO has 3 aseptic filling lines, each with 2 filling configurations:
  1 APS per line every six months = 3 lines × 2 runs/year = 6 APS runs/year (minimum)
  If personnel requalification APS is included = additional allowance for new or rotated personnel
  If event-driven APS is needed = depends on the number of deviations and changes

  A typical CDMO may need 10-20 APS runs per year
  Cost per APS (media + labor + line downtime) ≈ USD 15,000-50,000
  Annual APS budget ≈ USD 150,000-1,000,000

blocks.zh: 11.3 Event-Driven and For-Cause Ongoing Aseptic Process Simulation Assessment 11.3 事件驅動與有因性持續無菌製程模擬評估
blocks.en: 11.3 Event-Driven and For-Cause Ongoing Aseptic Process Simulation Assessment

blocks.zh: Event-Driven APS (事件驅動 APS)：與定期（時間驅動）APS 互補的另一種觸發機制。當製程發生重大變更或異常事件時，即使尚未到達半年的定期排程，也需要執行額外的 APS。這個觸發機制應整合在企業的變更管制系統（Change Control System）中。
blocks.en: Event-Driven APS: A trigger mechanism that complements periodic (time-driven) APS. When a significant process change or abnormal event occurs, an additional APS is needed even if the semiannual schedule has not yet been reached. This trigger should be integrated into the company's change control system.

blocks.zh: 定期 APS 和事件驅動 APS 的關係就像定期健康檢查和因症就醫：你每年都會做一次全身健檢（定期 APS），但如果中間突然出現異常症狀（設備故障、重大偏差），你不會等到下次年檢才去看醫生 — 你會立即就醫（事件驅動 APS）。兩者缺一不可。
blocks.en: The relationship between periodic APS and event-driven APS is like that between a regular health check-up and seeing a doctor when symptoms appear: you have a full check-up once a year (periodic APS), but if unusual symptoms suddenly appear in between (equipment failure, a major deviation), you do not wait for the next annual check-up. You see a doctor immediately (event-driven APS). You need both.

blocks.zh: 設施停機與長期閒置：這兩項是 CDMO 特別需要注意的觸發因素。CDMO 的產線利用率可能不均勻 — 某條線可能因為客戶訂單排程而閒置數月。在重新啟用前，需要評估是否需要事件驅動 APS。
blocks.en: Facility shutdown and extended idle periods: These two triggers deserve particular attention at a CDMO. Line utilization at a CDMO can be uneven, and a line may sit idle for months because of client order schedules. Before it is brought back into use, you need to assess whether an event-driven APS is required.

blocks.zh: 產線搬遷或退役前：在 decommissioning 或 relocating 之前執行 APS，目的是確認產線在最後運作期間仍處於受控狀態，這對於已出廠產品的品質保證至關重要。
blocks.en: Before line relocation or decommissioning: The purpose of running an APS before decommissioning or relocating is to confirm that the line remained in a state of control during its final period of operation. This is essential for assuring the quality of products already released.

blocks.zh: APS 次數依事件規模而定：小型變更可能只需 1 次 APS，但如果涉及重大設備更換或設施改造，可能需要回到初始驗證的標準（3 次）。
blocks.en: The number of APS runs depends on the scale of the event: A minor change may need only 1 APS run, but a major equipment replacement or facility modification may require a return to the initial validation standard (3 runs).

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 有一條充填線因為客戶暫停專案而閒置了 4 個月。在恢復生產前，需要做哪些評估來決定是否需要事件驅動 APS？
blocks.en: Your CDMO has a filling line that has been idle for 4 months because a client paused its project. What should be assessed before resuming production to decide whether an event-driven APS is needed?

blocks.zh: TR22 提到 APS 次數「may vary, depending upon the extent of the event」。在你的變更管制 SOP 中，你會如何分級不同類型的變更以決定所需的 APS 次數？
blocks.en: TR22 states that the number of APS runs "may vary, depending upon the extent of the event". In your change control SOP, how would you classify different types of changes to determine the number of APS runs required?

blocks.zh: 為什麼在產線退役前也需要執行 APS？這對已出廠的產品有什麼意義？
blocks.en: Why is an APS also needed before a line is decommissioned? What does this mean for products that have already been released?

blocks.zh: 11.4 Other Considerations 11.4 其他考量事項
blocks.en: 11.4 Other Considerations

blocks.zh: Bracket Approach (括弧法)：當同一條充填線有多種充填設定（不同速度、不同容器尺寸等），可以選擇極端條件（最大與最小）進行 APS，以涵蓋中間的所有組合。但此方法僅適用於參數之間有連續性關係的情況。
blocks.en: Bracket Approach: When the same filling line has multiple filling configurations (different speeds, container sizes and so on), you can run the APS under the extreme conditions (maximum and minimum) to cover all combinations in between. This approach applies only when the parameters have a continuous relationship.

blocks.zh: Rotational Basis (輪替基礎)：對於不適用括弧法的情況（例如完全不同的充填泵類型），可以採用輪替方式 — 每次定期 APS 涵蓋不同的製程組合，但每種組合至少每年挑戰一次。
blocks.en: Rotational Basis: Where bracketing is not applicable (for example, completely different filling pump types), a rotational approach can be used: each periodic APS covers a different combination of process conditions, but each combination is challenged at least once a year.

blocks.zh: Site Validation Master Plan (場地驗證總計畫)：輪替或括弧策略的理由必須記錄在場地層級的文件中，確保整體 APS 策略是有系統、有依據的，而不是隨意安排。
blocks.en: Site Validation Master Plan: The rationale for a rotational or bracketing strategy must be documented at site level, so that the overall APS strategy is systematic and justified rather than arbitrary.

blocks.zh: 括弧法就像測試手機電池壽命：你不需要在每一種使用模式下都測試，只要測試「最耗電模式」和「最省電模式」即可推論中間所有使用情境的表現。但如果你要測試的是 iPhone 和 Android 手機，它們是完全不同的系統，你不能用括弧法 — 必須各自獨立測試（輪替法）。
blocks.en: Bracketing is like testing the battery life of a phone: you do not need to test every usage mode; testing the "most power-hungry mode" and the "most power-saving mode" is enough to infer performance in all the modes in between. But if you are testing an iPhone and an Android phone, they are completely different systems, so you cannot use bracketing; each must be tested separately (rotational approach).

blocks.zh: CDMO 挑戰：CDMO 通常在同一條線上執行大量不同的產品/容器/速度組合。管理所有組合的 APS 覆蓋率是一項複雜的後勤工作。建議建立一個矩陣表，明確記錄哪些組合已透過 APS 驗證、哪些是透過括弧法覆蓋、哪些在輪替計畫中。這個矩陣應納入 Site Validation Master Plan。
blocks.en: CDMO challenge: A CDMO typically runs a large number of product, container and speed combinations on the same line. Managing APS coverage for all combinations is a complex logistical task. It is advisable to build a matrix table that clearly records which combinations have been validated by APS, which are covered by bracketing, and which are in the rotation plan. This matrix should be included in the Site Validation Master Plan.

blocks.zh: 情境：你的 CDMO A 線可以充填 2mL 小瓶（20,000 瓶/小時）和 20mL 大瓶（5,000 瓶/小時），使用同一款蠕動泵。此外，A 線也可以切換為旋轉活塞泵來充填高黏度懸浮液。
blocks.en: Scenario: Your CDMO's Line A can fill 2 mL vials (20,000 vials/hour) and 20 mL vials (5,000 vials/hour) using the same peristaltic pump. Line A can also be switched to a rotary piston pump to fill high-viscosity suspensions.

blocks.zh: 策略建議：
blocks.en: Recommended strategy:

blocks.zh: 2mL 與 20mL 瓶子（同款泵）：可採用括弧法，交替在定期 APS 中測試
blocks.en: 2 mL and 20 mL vials (same pump type): bracketing can be used, alternating between them in the periodic APS

blocks.zh: 蠕動泵 vs 旋轉活塞泵：必須各自獨立驗證，採用輪替方式確保每種至少每年一次
blocks.en: Peristaltic pump vs rotary piston pump: these must be validated independently, using a rotational approach to ensure each is covered at least once a year

blocks.zh: 記錄在 Site Validation Master Plan 中，包含覆蓋率矩陣與輪替排程
blocks.en: Document this in the Site Validation Master Plan, including the coverage matrix and the rotation schedule

blocks.zh: 12.0 References 12.0 參考文獻
blocks.en: 12.0 References

blocks.zh: 參考文獻架構：TR22 的 24 篇參考文獻可依來源分為以下幾類，幫助你理解無菌製程模擬的知識脈絡：
blocks.en: Structure of the references: The 24 references in TR22 can be grouped by source into the following categories, which helps you understand the body of knowledge behind aseptic process simulation:

blocks.zh: 法規指引（Ref 1, 4-6）：EU Annex 1（2022 年修訂版）與 FDA 無菌製造指引是 APS 要求的法規基礎
blocks.en: Regulatory guidance (Refs 1, 4-6): EU Annex 1 (2022 revision) and the FDA aseptic processing guidance are the regulatory basis for APS requirements

blocks.zh: 風險管理（Ref 8-12）：ICH Q9(R1)、PDA TR44、TR54 及 ANSI/PDA Standard 03-2025 構成了 APS 風險評估的方法論基礎
blocks.en: Risk management (Refs 8-12): ICH Q9(R1), PDA TR44, TR54 and ANSI/PDA Standard 03-2025 form the methodological basis for APS risk assessment

blocks.zh: 環境監測（Ref 2, 3）：PDA TR13-2 與 ISO 14644-1 定義了無菌環境的監測與分類標準
blocks.en: Environmental monitoring (Refs 2, 3): PDA TR13-2 and ISO 14644-1 define the standards for monitoring and classification of aseptic environments

blocks.zh: 滅菌與過濾（Ref 7, 22-24）：涵蓋 SIP、濕熱滅菌、除菌過濾及生物負荷管理
blocks.en: Sterilization and filtration (Refs 7, 22-24): Covers SIP, moist heat sterilization, sterilizing-grade filtration and bioburden management

blocks.zh: 污染控制（Ref 18, 21）：PDA TR90（CCS 開發）和 TR88（微生物偏差調查）直接支持 APS 失敗調查
blocks.en: Contamination control (Refs 18, 21): PDA TR90 (CCS development) and TR88 (microbial deviation investigations) directly support APS failure investigations

blocks.zh: 特殊應用（Ref 14-16）：冷凍乾燥產品 APS、ATMP 微生物控制、一次性系統
blocks.en: Special applications (Refs 14-16): APS for lyophilized products, microbial control for ATMPs, and single-use systems

blocks.zh: 必讀文件優先順序（針對 CDMO 從業人員）：
blocks.en: Priority reading list (for CDMO practitioners):

blocks.zh: 必讀 Ref 1 — EU Annex 1 (2022)：所有無菌製造的法規基石，APS 的章節要求已大幅更新
blocks.en: Essential Ref 1 - EU Annex 1 (2022): The regulatory cornerstone of all aseptic manufacturing; the APS requirements have been substantially updated

blocks.zh: 必讀 Ref 4 — FDA Aseptic Processing Guidance (2004)：雖然較早但仍是 FDA 現行指引，內含詳細的 APS 要求
blocks.en: Essential Ref 4 - FDA Aseptic Processing Guidance (2004): Although older, it remains the current FDA guidance and contains detailed APS requirements

blocks.zh: 重要 Ref 18 — PDA TR90 (CCS)：理解 APS 如何嵌入整體污染控制策略
blocks.en: Important Ref 18 - PDA TR90 (CCS): Explains how APS is embedded in the overall contamination control strategy

blocks.zh: 重要 Ref 8 — ICH Q9(R1)：風險管理的通用框架，適用於 APS 設計與調查
blocks.en: Important Ref 8 - ICH Q9(R1): The general framework for risk management, applicable to APS design and investigation

blocks.zh: 重要 Ref 21 — PDA TR88：APS 失敗後的微生物偏差調查方法論
blocks.en: Important Ref 21 - PDA TR88: Methodology for microbial deviation investigations after an APS failure

blocks.zh: 建議 Ref 14：冷凍乾燥 APS 的改良方法，對有 lyophilizer 的 CDMO 特別重要
blocks.en: Recommended Ref 14: Improved approaches to APS for lyophilized products; particularly important for a CDMO with a lyophilizer

blocks.zh: TR22 的參考文獻就像一張知識地圖：法規指引（Annex 1、FDA Guidance）是主幹道，定義了你必須走的方向；PDA 技術報告是地圖上的詳細街道圖，告訴你具體怎麼走；ICH 指引是交通規則，定義了風險管理的通用原則；而學術文獻則是當地居民的經驗分享，提供實務洞見。
blocks.en: The TR22 references are like a knowledge map: regulatory guidance (Annex 1, FDA Guidance) is the main road that defines the direction you must take; PDA technical reports are the detailed street maps that tell you exactly how to get there; ICH guidelines are the traffic rules that define the general principles of risk management; and academic literature is the local residents' shared experience, offering practical insight.

blocks.zh: 交叉引用提示 Cross-References
blocks.en: Cross-References

blocks.zh: 以下 TR22 參考文獻中的報告，本知識庫已有對應的教育材料：
blocks.en: For the following reports cited in the TR22 references, this knowledge base already has corresponding educational material:

blocks.zh: Ref 18 — PDA TR90：污染控制策略開發 → 可在本知識庫中查閱完整解析
blocks.en: Ref 18 - PDA TR90: Contamination control strategy development → a full analysis is available in this knowledge base

blocks.zh: Ref 23 — PDA TR26：除菌過濾 → 可在本知識庫中查閱完整解析
blocks.en: Ref 23 - PDA TR26: Sterilizing-grade filtration → a full analysis is available in this knowledge base

blocks.zh: 建議在學習 TR22 後，搭配閱讀 TR90（CCS）和 TR26（除菌過濾），以建立更完整的無菌製造知識體系。
blocks.en: After studying TR22, it is advisable to read TR90 (CCS) and TR26 (sterilizing-grade filtration) alongside it to build a more complete body of knowledge on aseptic manufacturing.

blocks.zh: EU Annex 1 (2022) 相較於 FDA 2004 年的指引，在 APS 要求上有哪些主要的差異與更新？
blocks.en: What are the main differences and updates in the APS requirements of EU Annex 1 (2022) compared with the 2004 FDA guidance?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 TR22 同時引用了 ICH Q9(R1)、PDA TR44 和 PDA TR54 三份風險管理文件？它們各自的側重點是什麼？
blocks.en: Why does TR22 cite three risk management documents, ICH Q9(R1), PDA TR44 and PDA TR54? What is the focus of each?

blocks.zh: 作為 CDMO 的品質主管，你會如何利用 TR88（微生物偏差調查）來強化你的 APS 失敗調查程序？
blocks.en: As a CDMO quality head, how would you use TR88 (microbial deviation investigations) to strengthen your APS failure investigation procedure?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: APS 失敗調查必須全面且系統化：涵蓋微生物鑑定、EM 數據比對、設備維護記錄、人員訪談、影像回顧、滅菌紀錄、清潔消毒紀錄等多個維度，並且不能在未確定可歸因原因之前恢復生產
blocks.en: An APS failure investigation must be comprehensive and systematic: It covers microbial identification, EM data comparison, equipment maintenance records, personnel interviews, video review, sterilization records, cleaning and disinfection records and other dimensions, and production must not resume before an assignable cause has been determined

blocks.zh: 回溯評估的範圍與時間框架必須有依據：不能機械式地「追溯到上次成功 APS」，而要根據失敗原因的性質來決定。間歇性故障可能需要回溯所有效期內批次；共用設備問題可能影響多條產線
blocks.en: The scope and time frame of the retrospective evaluation must be justified: It should not mechanically be "back to the last successful APS"; it should be determined by the nature of the failure cause. Intermittent faults may require looking back over all batches within the applicable period, and problems with shared equipment may affect multiple lines

blocks.zh: 持續性 APS 分為時間驅動與事件驅動兩種：時間驅動為半年一次（單次即可），事件驅動則在重大變更、設施停機、長期閒置、APS 失敗後額外執行，次數依事件規模而定
blocks.en: Ongoing APS is either time-driven or event-driven: Time-driven APS is performed every six months (a single run is sufficient). Event-driven APS is performed additionally after major changes, facility shutdowns, extended idle periods and APS failures, and the number of runs depends on the scale of the event

blocks.zh: 多種製程組合可透過括弧法或輪替法管理 APS 覆蓋率：但前提是策略有文件依據，記錄在 Site Validation Master Plan 中，且每種組合至少每年挑戰一次
blocks.en: Multiple process combinations can be managed through bracketing or rotation: This requires that the strategy be documented and recorded in the Site Validation Master Plan, and that each combination be challenged at least once a year

blocks.zh: TR22 的 24 篇參考文獻構成了完整的知識框架：從法規基礎（EU Annex 1、FDA Guidance）到風險管理（ICH Q9）到具體技術（TR90 CCS、TR88 微生物調查），為 APS 的設計、執行與調查提供了全方位的支持
blocks.en: The 24 references in TR22 form a complete knowledge framework: From the regulatory basis (EU Annex 1, FDA Guidance) to risk management (ICH Q9) to specific techniques (TR90 CCS, TR88 microbial investigations), they provide comprehensive support for the design, execution and investigation of APS
